traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Ripogonaceae: leaves alternate, opposite or whorled; leaves simple; veins palmate; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in racemes or in spikes, rarely in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit berry; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
